tetris.TITLE: Human Tetris
tetris.HEADLINE: Become the missing piece.
tetris.DESCRIPTION: A wall is coming. Find the shape, strike the pose, and slip right through.
tetris.SHORTCONTROLS: DEMO: 1–9, 0, Z X C V B select 15 poses
tetris.MISSION: Match 15 different silhouettes, once each in a random order. Keep both feet on the floor and hold each pose steady as the wall arrives.
tetris.TIP: Small adjustments count. Watch your wrists, elbows and feet.
tetris.CAMERACONTROLS: Copy the target silhouette with both feet on the floor. Follow raised-arm, low-V, diagonal and cross-body shapes. Keep both hands visible, including when bringing them near your chest. Left and right refer to the mirrored on-screen silhouette. Hold the match during the last moments before the wall reaches you. No jumping, single-leg balancing, spinning or floor poses are required.
tetris.DEMOCONTROLS: Use keys 1–9 and 0 for the first ten poses, then Z, X, C, V and B for the last five. You can also select any of the 15 pose buttons below the arena.
